value: Sandbox game where you collect food around a level to grow a roaming giantess, contains unlockable modifiers when completing a level.

Explore a castle town, avoid traps, and collect food items from houses to submit in collection zones while a neutral giantess NPC roams around, destroying anything she steps on. Each completed zone makes the giantess grow larger.
